text:
ana_support: Customer ACME (acct: acme-42) filed an escalated ticket: their webhook consumer started getting "invalid JSON" errors in structured_output mode after today's canary weight rotation. They say it started ~10:15 UTC and affects ~5% of requests.

kevin_se: Can you paste a failing response and the request that triggered it? Also which model tag did the customer pin (if any)?

ana_support: They didn't pin a tag. Quick failing example from their logs (they scrubbed tokens):

lucas_repro: Repro steps I used locally: set model=llama5b, structured_output=true, temperature=0, and hit the endpoint with the prompt below. I got a 400 from our parser with "unexpected token at position 1".

```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "llama5b",
  "structured_output": true,
  "input": "Please return items as JSON array of objects: [{\"id\":1,\"label\":\"a\"}]"
}
```

lucas_repro: Failing response (raw stream capture):

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
{
  "id": "resp_789",
  "choices": [
    {
      "delta": "{\"items\": [",
      "delta_meta": "chunk:1/3"
    },
    {
      "delta": "{\"id\":\"1\",\"label\":\"a\"},",
      "delta_meta": "chunk:2/3"
    },
    {
      "delta": "], \"meta\": {\"source\":\"llama5b-v43\"}}",
      "delta_meta": "chunk:3/3"
    }
  ]
}
```

lucas_repro: When the client concatenates chunks naively it ends up with an extra leading "{" in chunk 2 (weird double-brace) so final payload becomes: "{{\"items\": ..." which breaks strict JSON parsers. If you strip the first char from chunk 2 it parses fine. The chunk boundaries look different from yesterday's build (v42).

ml-oncall-bot: Canary rotation completed: model-llama5b weights -> v43 promoted at 2026-03-16T03:21:00Z. Rolling windows: 10%. No other infra changes during window.

kevin_se: Sounds like structured_output streaming framing changed between v42 and v43. Lucas, can you diff the tokenizer/kafka framing layer or runtime that wraps stream deltas? Check whether we added an auto-wrap helper that inserts braces for small sequences.

lucas_repro: Confirmed: runtime commit 7f9 added a "chunk_self_wrap" optimization to avoid small partial tokens being dropped. It prepends "{" on chunk boundaries to preserve object starts for some models. That interacts badly with clients expecting exact continuation chunks.

maria_prod: Customer is hitting production webhook parser (strict JSON) and they can't handle the double-brace. They asked for an immediate mitigation: either rollback the canary to v42 for their region or return non-streaming full assembled JSON for pinned accounts.

ana_support: Customer requested rollback. CS asked if we can do a tenant-scoped fallback.

kevin_se: Short-term: create a per-customer routing rule to fall back to v42 for acme-42 and schedule a hotfix to remove chunk_self_wrap or change framing to emit chunk metadata instead of modifying payload characters. I'll open a PR to revert the runtime change and request a canary rollback for acme's region.

lucas_repro: I can push a canary hotfix that disables chunk_self_wrap at runtime config. Repro verifies client parses correctly after disabling.

maria_prod: Customer asked for timeline: can we do rollback in 30–60 min? They already sent a diff of 25 failing webhooks.

kevin_se: Ops: please set routing rule for tenant acme-42 -> model-llama5b:v42 and TTL 24h. I'll coordinate rollback PR.

ana_support: Filed ticket INC-2026-ACME-JSON and notified CS. I'll keep customer updated.

kevin_se: Thanks. Followup TODOs: 1) ops routing rule, 2) revert commit 7f9 or change to non-mutating framing, 3) add regression test that concatenates stream deltas and validates strict JSON, 4) release note for structured_output streaming behavior change.

lucas_repro: Adding regression test now. Will post PR link when ready.

maria_prod: Customer appreciates quick response. :thumbsup:
